title: Arbc Legends
description: A Minecraft PvP/resource pack that represents Arab identity with a clean, elegant, and professional design. Compatible with Java Edition (1.6.1 - 1.8.9).
body: Turn your sword into an ultimate slipper of doom and your armor into refreshing Almarai milk. A fun, meme-style resource pack that adds an Arabic twist without changing gameplay. Perfect for trolling friends or making hilarious videos!
